question:
Which of the following statement is correct regarding the election of Vice president of India?

I. He should have completed 35 years of age.

II. He should be qualified for election as a member of the Council of States.
solution:
The correct answer is __**3) Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement I: He should have completed 35 years of age**:

 The **Vice President** of India must have attained the age of **35 years** as per Article 66 of the **Constitution of India**. This is a mandatory eligibility criterion for being elected to the office of the Vice President. ***Hence, this statement is correct.***
 
• **Statement II: He should be qualified for election as a member of the Council of States**:

 Under Article 66(3)(b) of the Indian Constitution, the Vice President must be eligible for election as a member of the **Rajya Sabha (Council of States)**. This means he/she should fulfill the qualifications mentioned in Article 84, including being a citizen of India, at least 30 years old, and meeting other criteria. ***Hence, this statement is also correct.***
